name: Community — MiniMax H3 (10Eros Max beta7)
author: TenStrip
description: MiniMax H3 on TenStrip's 10Eros Max beta7 8-step TURBO: FL2VA base, FastH3 Omni timestep table, turbo built into the weights, 22.9 GB INT8 HQ. Three single-pass cards at 8 steps and two 768p two-pass cards. Runs dense rather than the author's sparse attention; the card text says why. A separate download from the beta5 and beta6 packs. The 10Eros terms on the author's page apply alongside the MiniMax H3 licence.

presets.name: MiniMax H3 Text to Video (10Eros Max beta7)
presets.description:
TenStrip's 10Eros Max beta7 8-step TURBO (INT8 HQ, 22.9 GB): the FL2VA base with FastH3 Omni's timestep table and LoRA data merged into the MLP layers, so the turbo is in the checkpoint and there is no LoRA to load. er_sde / sgm_uniform, 8 steps, sigma shift 12 video / 3 audio, the author's settings. The Steps control covers the author's 6 to 12; only 8 was tested here.

Dense on purpose. The author's sample workflow runs sparse attention (VSA at 10%) and warns of moving blotches without it, but this checkpoint has no VSA gate layers, so the engine runs VSA without its coarse branch. On 15 dense clips against the same clips on VSA (5 s, 864x480, three prompts plus I2V and R2V, three seeds each) VSA was 9-37% softer, saved about 7% of the time, and showed no consistent flicker gain. Frames and flicker measurements showed no blotches on dense. Sol-Attn and Spectrum are not offered; they were not tested.

Compared 2026-10-30 with beta5 and beta6 (RTX 4070 Ti 12 GB, 31 GB RAM, engine 0.43.0): the scripted line came out in every I2V and scene-reference clip, duel staging kept both fighters in frame more often, and sound runs louder than beta6 and quieter than beta5. Audio tone was not judged by ear, and no LoRAs were tested: users on the author's page report some LoRAs flicker on this model.

Text to video: about 80 s for 5 s at 864x480 in the app.
presets.tagline: 10Eros Max beta7: turbo built in, 8 steps, no LoRA

presets.name: MiniMax H3 Text to Video 768p Two-Pass (10Eros Max beta7)
presets.description:
TenStrip's 10Eros Max beta7 8-step TURBO (INT8 HQ, 22.9 GB): the FL2VA base with FastH3 Omni's timestep table and LoRA data merged into the MLP layers, so the turbo is in the checkpoint and there is no LoRA to load. er_sde / sgm_uniform, 8 steps, sigma shift 12 video / 3 audio, the author's settings. Audio tone was not judged by ear, and no LoRAs were tested: users on the author's page report some LoRAs flicker on this model.

Two-pass 768p: a 0.55x first pass at 8 steps, the 3D latent upscaler, then 3 steps beta at 0.35 denoise at your chosen size, with the soundtrack taken from the first pass. This is the recipe from LokkenJP's beta7 workflow without its sparse attention. Default size 1344x768; 149-161 s for 5 s in the app, 122-147 s on nine runs against the engine, roughly twice the single-pass card, with as little as 6.0 GB of system RAM left, so close other work first. On sparse attention, two-pass beat a direct 768p render on face detail; dense looked much the same by eye but was not measured against direct 768p. Only 5 s clips were tested.
presets.tagline: 10Eros Max beta7: two passes to 768p, turbo built in

MEASURED 2026-10-30 (RTX 4070 Ti 12 GB, 31 GB RAM, 864x480, 5 s, engine 0.43.0): 80-84 s in the app with Sage attention, 70-72 s against the engine with kitchen attention. Two-pass adds the 0.69 GB latent upscaler and its custom node; default 1344x768, 5 s: 149-161 s in the app, 122-147 s against the engine, free RAM down to 6.0 GB.
